steps.notice: New insurance terms: from now on a pallet, load included, may weigh at most 800 kg (was 1,000 kg).
After a near-miss we are lowering the indoor forklift speed limit to 8 km/h (was 10 km/h).
Our haulier switched to a lighter trailer fleet: trailer payload is now 22,000 kg (was 24,000 kg).
Shift supervisors may now approve damaged-goods write-offs up to 750 EUR; above that the warehouse manager approves (was 500 EUR).
With the new loading crew each outbound door now handles 4 trailer loads per shift (was 3).
